subject: City Charter Review Process
overview: The Governance Committee discussed the city charter review process and outlined a multi-meeting schedule to evaluate proposed charter changes. The committee voted to distribute compiled Charter Study Committee materials and collect member feedback ahead of future topic-specific discussions.

items.title: Resolution to Discuss Updates to the City Charter
items.summary: Approved a motion directing the chair to distribute compiled Charter Study Committee recommendations to councilors for feedback before holding focused review sessions, aiming to finalize proposals by March for the November 2025 ballot.
